subject.title: fix(agents): expose filesystem tool results in Code Mode

question: Should Code Mode result contracts be exposed through the shared `ToolDefinition.outputSchema` seam rather than remaining a filesystem-specific bridge?
rationale: The patch is narrowly implemented, but it establishes a reusable contract surface for session tools and should be accepted intentionally by the owners of Code Mode and the session-tool abstraction.

options.title: Adopt the shared contract seam
options.body: Approve `outputSchema` as the common tool-local result-contract mechanism and land the filesystem implementations as its first callers.

options.title: Keep the repair filesystem-specific
options.body: Request a narrower Code Mode bridge if maintainers do not want session tools to expose reusable structured output contracts yet.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared contract seam
recommendation.body: Approve `outputSchema` as the common tool-local result-contract mechanism and land the filesystem implementations as its first callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this person directly to the proposed Code Mode contract design; broader current-main ownership could not be established from the supplied inspection data.
